_metadata.description: SDA operational targets from the PRD.

requirements.title: Declared dependency extraction
requirements.description: Parse scenario service metadata and extract declared resource and scenario dependencies.

requirements.title: Retained non-import scenario signals
requirements.description: Retain supported Vrooli command and workflow usage signals until AST facts replace them.

requirements.title: Dependency metadata storage
requirements.description: Persist history-bearing dependency metadata and analysis records in the domain store.

requirements.title: Interactive dependency graph UI
requirements.description: Render graph data with operator controls, status states, and selected-node details.

requirements.title: Semantic scenario matching
requirements.description: Use Qdrant and embeddings for proposed-scenario similarity with deterministic fallback behavior.

requirements.title: CLI graph access
requirements.description: Expose graph, drift, optimization, and export workflows through the SDA CLI.

requirements.title: API graph access
requirements.description: Serve REST and Connect endpoints for dependency and graph consumers.

requirements.title: Actual interface graph
requirements.description: Compute actual scenario edges from proto-health and code-facts batch facts.

requirements.title: Dependency drift reporting
requirements.description: Compare actual import evidence with declared scenario dependencies using asymmetric severity.

requirements.title: Connect graph seam
requirements.description: Expose DescribeInterfaceGraph as the reusable Connect contract for downstream planners.

requirements.title: SQLite storage cutover
requirements.description: Run SDA on SQLite with embedded domain-owned schemas and no Postgres runtime dependency.

requirements.title: Optimization recommendations
requirements.description: Recommend resource swaps and dependency reductions for lighter deployments.

requirements.title: Dependency impact analysis
requirements.description: Explain which scenarios or resources are affected if a dependency is removed.

requirements.title: Dependency history
requirements.description: Track dependency changes over time for regression and trend analysis.

requirements.title: Graph export formats
requirements.description: Export dependency graphs as JSON, DOT/GraphViz, and image-ready data.

requirements.title: Cycle detection
requirements.description: Detect circular scenario or resource dependency chains.

requirements.title: Resource cost estimation
requirements.description: Estimate resource cost and deployment weight from dependency depth and resource classes.
